title: Block devices and encrypted volumes
whyItMatters: The disk layout shows which volumes are LUKS-encrypted and which are plain. It is the only reliable way to tell a buyer whether the data on the machine is actually protected.
source: lsblk(8) from util-linux reports device name, type, filesystem type and mountpoint as JSON; the engine parses that output: https://man.archlinux.org/man/lsblk.8
notes: A LUKS volume shows fstype crypto_LUKS; an opened mapper device shows up separately. Names, types and mountpoints only, no key material. On systems without lsblk the engine records the query as unavailable.

cleanup.risk: Disk layout and volume encryption status are hardware configuration reports and cannot be manually deleted.
cleanup.reason: This is an operating system query showing disk partition layout and encryption state. No cleanup is required.
